q1.explanationZh: laser 名词“激光”，laser radiation“激光辐射”。

q2.explanationZh: last 形容词“最近过去的；最后的”，名词“最后的人（或事物）”，如 last week、at last。

q3.explanationZh: late 形容词“迟的；晚的”，也作副词“迟；晚”，如 be late for“迟到”。

q4.explanationZh: lately 副词“近来，最近”，常与现在完成时连用；注意它不是 late 的“晚”的意思。

q5.explanationZh: later 是 late 的比较级，“较晚的；较晚地”，如 two months later“两个月后”。

q6.explanationZh: latest 是 late 的最高级，表示“最新的”，如 his latest book“他的新书”。

q7.explanationZh: latter 形容词“后者的；后一半的”，注意双写 t，the latter“后者”。

q8.explanationZh: laugh 动词“笑”，名词“笑；笑声”（可数），laugh at“嘲笑”。

q9.explanationZh: laughter 是不可数名词“笑；笑声”，burst into laughter“突然大笑起来”。

q10.explanationZh: launch 动词“发射；开办”，名词“发射；（船）下水”，launch a rocket“发射火箭”。

q11.explanationZh: laundry 名词“洗衣店；洗衣房”。

q12.explanationZh: lavatory 名词“厕所；盥洗室”，注意拼写 lav-a-tory。

q13.explanationZh: law 名词“法律”，派生词 lawyer“律师”。

q14.explanationZh: lawn 名词“草坪”，mow the lawn“修剪草坪”。

q16.explanationZh: lay 及物动词“放置”，过去式 laid；注意与不及物动词 lie“躺”区分。

q17.explanationZh: layer 名词“层”，a layer of clay“一层黏土”。

q19.explanationZh: lead 动词“带领；导致”，过去式 led；名词“领先地位”，take the lead“带头”。

q20.explanationZh: lead 加 -er 表示人，leader“领导者”。

q21.explanationZh: leader 加 -ship 构成名词 leadership“领导；领导地位”。

q22.explanationZh: leaf 名词“叶”，复数 leaves；作动词 leaf through“翻阅”。

q23.explanationZh: leaflet 名词“传单”，advertising leaflets“广告传单”。

q24.explanationZh: league 名词“联盟；协会”，注意词尾 -gue。

q25.explanationZh: leak 动词“漏；泄露”，名词“裂缝；漏洞”。

q26.explanationZh: lean 动词、名词“倾斜；靠”，lean against“靠在……上”。

q27.explanationZh: leap 动词、名词“跳，跃”，过去式 leapt 或 leaped。

q28.explanationZh: learn 动词“学习；得知”，learn of“获悉”。

q29.explanationZh: learned 作形容词时读 /ˈlɜːnɪd/，意为“有学问的；博学的”。

q30.explanationZh: learning 名词“学习；学问”，the key to learning“学习的关键”。

q31.explanationZh: be late for“迟到”，for 后接迟到的事，如 be late for school。

q32.explanationZh: late (in) doing“做……迟了”，in 可以省略，后接动名词。

q33.explanationZh: sit/stay up late“熬夜；迟睡”，late 在这里是副词。

q35.explanationZh: sooner or later“迟早”，是固定搭配，前后都是比较级。

q36.explanationZh: the latter“后者”，与 the former“前者”相对。

q38.explanationZh: 手册中 lay off 释义为“停下休息”。

q39.explanationZh: lead to“通向；导致”，to 是介词，后接名词或动名词。

q40.explanationZh: lean against/on/upon“靠在……上；依靠”，三个介词都可以。

q42.explanationZh: lay sth. on ...“把某物放在……上”，lay 是及物动词“放置”。

q43.explanationZh: lay/place/put emphasis/importance on“强调，重视”，介词用 on。

q44.explanationZh: learn ... by heart“熟记，背诵”，by heart“凭记忆”。

q45.explanationZh: learn/draw a lesson from“从……中吸取教训”，介词用 from。

q46.explanationZh: since last week“自上周以来”，last“最近过去的”。

q47.explanationZh: 句子用现在完成时，lately“最近”常与现在完成时连用。

q48.explanationZh: the last of ...“……中的最后一个”，last 在这里作名词。

q49.explanationZh: sit up late“熬夜”，late 是副词“晚”，不能用 lately。

q51.explanationZh: a ... laugh“一阵笑”，laugh 作可数名词，前面有 a，所以不用 laughter。

q52.explanationZh: 和 3 点的晚版相比，5 点的是“更晚的”一版，用比较级 later。

q53.explanationZh: 两者中的“后者”，the latter，这里指 swim。

q54.explanationZh: were 后接过去分词构成被动语态，“火箭被发射”，launched。

q55.explanationZh: a 后接可数名词单数，become a lawyer“成为律师”。

q56.sampleAnswer: The late twentieth century witnessed the rapid development of China’s economy.
references: The late twentieth century witnessed the rapid development of China’s economy.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q56.explanationZh: “20 世纪末”= the late twentieth century，late 表示“晚期的”；witness 表示“见证”。

q57.sampleAnswer: Accompanied by the leader, they visited the hospital.
references: Accompanied by the leader, they visited the hospital.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q57.explanationZh: “在……的陪同下”用过去分词短语 accompanied by ...，“领导”= leader。

q58.sampleAnswer: Rockets are being successfully launched and continuously updated, symbolising the increasingly strong national strength and rapid technological advancement of our country.
references: Rockets are being successfully launched and continuously updated, symbolising the increasingly strong national strength and rapid technological advancement of our country.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q58.explanationZh: “火箭被发射”用被动语态 be launched，正在进行用 are being launched；“象征”用现在分词 symbolising 作状语。

q59.sampleAnswer: He always takes the lead in response to the government’s call.
references: He always takes the lead in response to the government’s call.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: “带头”= take the lead，lead 作名词；“响应”= in response to。

q60.sampleAnswer: A careless comment of his has led to some unnecessary misunderstandings.
references: A careless comment of his has led to some unnecessary misunderstandings.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “引起，导致”= lead to，过去分词 led；“他的一句评论”= a comment of his。

q61.sampleAnswer: The funny story told by Michael made the little girl laugh.
references: The funny story told by Michael made the little girl laugh.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “使某人笑”= make sb. laugh，make 后接不带 to 的动词原形；“Michael 讲的故事”= the story told by Michael。

q62.sampleAnswer: He says his latest book will be published next week.
references: He says his latest book will be published next week.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “新书”可译为 his latest book（最新的书）；“出版”用被动语态 be published。

q63.sampleAnswer: He is a serious scholar, a genuinely learned man.
references: He is a serious scholar, a genuinely learned man.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “有学问的人”= a learned man，learned 作形容词“博学的”；“真正地”= genuinely。

q64.sampleAnswer: No children make no mistake while they are growing up and the most important thing is whether they can learn from (the) mistakes.
references: No children make no mistake while they are growing up and the most important thing is whether they can learn from (the) mistakes.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “吃一堑，长一智”可译为 learn from (the) mistakes“从错误中学习”；“关键在于能否……”= the most important thing is whether ...。

q65.sampleAnswer: Despite the serious air pollution, policemen still stick to their posts in the rush hour and strictly carry out the law to ensure the smooth traffic.
references: Despite the serious air pollution, policemen still stick to their posts in the rush hour and strictly carry out the law to ensure the smooth traffic.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “执法”= carry out the law；“坚守岗位”= stick to one’s post；“尽管”= despite + 名词。
